title: Unity Catalog Scala and Java UDFs and Scalar and Batch Unity Catalog Python UDFs will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Unity Catalog Scala and Java UDFs and Scalar and Batch Unity Catalog Python UDFs will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled in November 2026.

See [Python UDF feature requirements](/aws/en/udf/unity-catalog#ga-feature-requirements) and [Scala and Java user-defined functions (UDFs) in Unity Catalog](/aws/en/udf/scala-java-uc).

ref_links.text: Scala and Java user-defined functions (UDFs) in Unity Catalog
